desc: Implement a segment tree with sequence-monoid summaries and true empty-leaf identity.
Temporarily delete and restore all occurrences of each distinct value; query the root maximum subarray sum in \(O(n\log n)\) total update complexity.
Include the original array as the no-deletion candidate and reject results from deleting every element.
Verify examples, all-negative arrays, single-element arrays, repeated values, and deletion of all occurrences.
Identify the per-value DP concept and its initialization pitfalls.
Consider alternative occurrence-gap and persistent-segment-tree approaches.
